reason: The goal is to reinforce the frameworks, and bone mineral appears suited to strengthening them.
expectation: I expect the mineral to reinforce the living frameworks into bone, though I'm not sure what the resulting item will be called.

effect: The mineral reinforced the living framework into arm bones, and the next goal is to stabilize the joint and attach the muscles.
reaction: The reminder that bone remains living tissue is useful.
reason: Cartilage is the only offered combination, and its smooth caps appear suited to the facing elbow surfaces.
expectation: I expect the cartilage to cover the ends of the elbow bones, helping form the joint surfaces.

effect: The cartilage covers the bone ends and spreads force over a wider area, reducing pressure at the contact point.
reaction: The comparison makes cartilage's cushioning role clear.
reason: Joint fluid is the only offered combination, and it belongs between the joint surfaces.
expectation: I expect the fluid to lubricate the cushioned surfaces so they can move more smoothly.

effect: The fluid forms a film between the cartilage surfaces and also helps nourish the cartilage.
reaction: The nourishment role was a useful surprise.
reason: Ligaments are the only offered combination, and their pictured connections between bones suggest they will stabilize the elbow.
expectation: I expect the ligaments to join the neighboring bones and help hold the joint stable while it moves.

effect: The ligaments hold the joint together, and the framework now has slots for both opposing muscle pulls.
reaction: The marked attachment points make the next construction clear.
reason: I'll attach the bending muscles to begin filling the framework's pull slots.
expectation: I expect the bending muscles to fit into the front pull slot, leaving the rear slot open.

alternatives.reason: The straightening muscles should also fit, but I chose to start with the front pull.

effect: The bending muscles are attached, and their pull bends the elbow; the straightening muscles remain to be fitted.
reaction: The pull arrow makes the bending muscle's role clear.
reason: The straightening muscles are the only offered combination and should complete the opposing pulls.
expectation: I expect the straightening muscles to fit into the rear pull slot and help straighten the elbow.

effect: The straightening muscles complete the arm framework. The result explains that opposite movements need opposing muscle pulls because a relaxing muscle cannot push the bone back.
reaction: The paired poses give a clear explanation of why both muscle groups are needed.

mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the straightening muscles was most worthwhile because the result connected both muscle groups to opposite movements and explained why both are needed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the bending muscles was fairly predictable: the marked slot and the compatible-partner menu made the next action clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that joint fluid also helps nourish cartilage, which has no blood vessels of its own.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and goals gave each part a clear purpose, although most steps had only one offered combination.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the constructed arm connects to other body systems. The explanation of opposing pulls made the final construction interesting, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
